subject: Inter-cloud harmonization: approval request for non-standard rev-share + term alignment
body:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
To: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Inter-cloud harmonization: approval request for non-standard rev-share + term alignment

Hi Karthik / Marissa,

Following our call last week with CloudSpan (Kate) and Stratify (Tom), they want a single private-offer listing that spans AWS and GCP. Because of differing marketplace fees and the customer's go-to-production timelines, legal is asking for a couple of deviations from our standard private-offer template:

- Unified term (24 months) with a single SKU but tiered rev-share (AWS 16%, GCP 21%) rather than our standard 12% across the board.
- Billing: customer requests Net-60 with invoicing from Redwood for GCP (marketplace passes through) — this is a carveout from our typical Net-30 for private offers.
- Revenue recognition note: customer wants a clause that splits refunds/chargebacks to be handled pro-rata across clouds.

Attachments: AWSPvtOffer_TermSheet_v3.pdf (term sheet with proposed language) and GCP_Private_Pricing_Comparison.xlsx (fee waterfall + margin calc).

Why this matters: CloudSpan is committing to a 2-year consumption estimate that would exceed $3.2M ARR if both clouds go live in parallel. The higher rev-share on GCP is to offset a 6% marketplace surcharge and an estimated additional integration/ops cost. If we keep our standard rev-share the customer will either not commit to GCP or push all spend to AWS which reduces our strategic multi-cloud positioning.

Ask: I need exec approval to sign off on the two deviations above (non-standard rev-share schedule + Net-60 billing for GCP) and permission to confirm the term-clause language that allocates refund responsibility pro-rata. If approved, I'll route final docs to Legal for a quick redline and then to Kate/Tom for signature (DocuSign link included).

Quick bullets for decision:
- Financial impact: ~8% incremental unit margin hit in year 1 if both clouds are used; offset by higher overall ARR and quicker adoption across customer GCP teams.
- Sales comp: propose standard commission on recognized revenue; ask Deal Desk to confirm if commission needs a one-time adjust.
- Recommended controls if approved: cap rev-share concession to first 12 months on GCP if usage below $750k in year 1.

Neha
Neha Kapoor
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Attachment: AWSPvtOffer_TermSheet_v3.pdf

-----Original Message-----
From: karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com; marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Tue, 27 Jun 2028 11:04:05 -07:00
Subject: Re: Inter-cloud harmonization: approval request for non-standard rev-share + term alignment

Neha — thanks for the thorough write-up. A couple of follow-ups from Partnerships:

1) Can you confirm whether the GCP surcharge is fixed (marketplace fee) or depending on usage? If fixed, we should use a per-invoice line-item so future reconciliations are clear.
2) For Sales comp, Marissa and I prefer a one-time override instead of changing base comp structure. If deal lands, we pay a 15% one-time quota credit to you and keep recurring comp unchanged.

Also looping Jonas for revenue ops & billing implications.

Karthik
Karthik Iyer
SVP, Partnerships | Redwood Inference

On Wed, 28 Jun 2028 08:22:13 -0700, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com wrote:
From: marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com
Cc: jonas_weber@redwoodinference.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jun 2028 08:22:13 -0700
Subject: Re: Inter-cloud harmonization: approval request for non-standard rev-share + term alignment

Folks — I ran the numbers with Finance. Summary:
- If we accept AWS 16% / GCP 21% rev-share, projected contribution margin for the account in year 1 is ~22% after marketplace fees and estimated onboarding costs.
- Net-60 introduces a cash timing risk; finance wants either a short-term credit line or a milestone schedule where 25% invoiced at go-live, remainder on Net-60.

Finance requests a signoff from Revenue Leadership for Net-60 and from Legal for the refund allocation clause.

Marissa Cole
Director, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
Attachment: GCP_Private_Pricing_Comparison.xlsx

-----Original Message-----
From: Kate Brown <kate.brown@cloudspan.com>
To: neha.kapoor@redwoodinference.com
Cc: tom.li@stratifysys.com
Date: Wed, 28 Jun 2028 12:37:58 -04:00
Subject: Re: Private listing + multi-cloud ask

Neha — appreciate the transparency. CloudSpan's procurement team is fine with the term length but needs Net-60 for GCP due to their own billing cycles. They are flexible on a small performance milestone payment at activation (we suggested 20%). Would Redwood be willing to cap the higher GCP rev-share to 12 months, after which it reverts to standard? That would help their CFO model the migration.

Kate Brown
Head of Cloud Partnerships | CloudSpan Inc.
Attachment: Procurement_Comment_Log.docx

-----Original Message-----
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com, karthik_iyer@redwoodinference.com, marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com
Date: Thu, 29 Jun 2028 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Approval: conditional exec sign-off for inter-cloud private-offer

Neha / Karthik / Marissa — after reviewing Finance and Partnerships' notes I approve the deviations with the following conditions: 

1) GCP rev-share at 21% is approved but capped to first 12 months; revert to standard 12% thereafter unless usage > $1.5M in year 2 (in which case we re-evaluate).
2) Net-60 for GCP approved only if we secure a 20% activation milestone invoice (invoice payable on go-live) and include a late-payment interest clause in the private-offer.
3) All customer-facing language on refunds & chargebacks must be approved by Legal; route the final term sheet to Legal with these conditions and copy Revenue Ops.

Please confirm you will update the term sheet and route to Legal + DocuSign. If Legal signs off quickly we can finalize today.

Jonas Weber
VP, Revenue Strategy | Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com

-----Forwarded attachment stubs-----
- AWSPvtOffer_TermSheet_v3.pdf (PDF, 18 pages)
- GCP_Private_Pricing_Comparison.xlsx (Excel, 3 sheets)
